text: Kingsmoor FC is awarded a penalty near the right side of the Westport Albion goal, about 9.7 metres from the goal line at the near end. Viktor Quinlan steps up and calmly strikes the ball with his foot into the net, giving Kingsmoor FC a 1-0 lead just eight minutes into the match. This goal comes immediately after a foul by Westport Albion’s Joon Sato and marks a shift in the game’s momentum. Despite Westport Albion’s greater possession, Kingsmoor FC takes the early advantage from this set-piece opportunity. [#151] [#152]
